work.title: Untitled (Dense Collage Field)
work.description: Dense mixed-media collage covering a large horizontal field with overlapping printed fragments, drawn lines, concentric rings, and geometric shapes. Red rectangles anchor the upper-left and lower-right corners, while black-and-white circular targets, yellow vertical stripes, and scattered photographic elements fill the white ground.
work.composition: dense horizontal field with corner anchors
keywords: dense layered collage with concentric rings
